answer: One concrete defense is to make every agent post a refundable stake bond before it can transact, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds. Identity becomes a cipher-signed key, not a free handle, and a shared reputation ledger hangs like a lantern over each actor's history: misbehave and your bond burns. Sybil scale stops being cheap, because an attacker can no longer hide a fake fleet behind an ivory-tower pseudonym when capital, not clicks, gates entry.
